name: sandoq
description: A live pane, band and toasts for the room's run folder: cards, walks, taps, the seat's answers and the shelf; the bridge hooks make each message a card

bridge.title: Bridge
bridge.description: on makes each message a card and gives the session the room's reading; off (or no, false, 0) turns the hooks off

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: The room's instance a bridged card lands on, the one the pane shows; empty reads it from room.sh

sandoq.title: Sandoq
sandoq.description: The path of the sandoq program, which runs the words of a room found by its mark; empty looks for it on the PATH, then under the sandoq home
